messages:
joan: deploy-bot just opened a canary alert for payments-service in eu-west-1, 30% error rate and scheduling failures during scale-up. 5/10 pods ErrorScheduling. anyone see this?

deploy-bot: [alert] canary failing: payments-service:v1.5.0-canary · canary=eu-west-1 · failures=5/10 · reason=FailedScheduling
logs: 
```
0/3 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient cpu.
```
joan: looks like cluster-autoscaler didn't add nodes in time, pods stuck pending.

sre-bot: fyi autoscaler was noisy in the last hour in eu-west-1 — scale-up events + preemptions. Could be spike + PDBs preventing eviction.

adele: hmm 2 options: pin chart back to v1.4.2 and rollforward later, or add a short scheduling grace to the canary so it waits for scale-up before marking unhealthy.

mohit: pin makes the most sense for customer-facing payments path. Do we have a quick helm values patch we can apply?

luca: agree with pin + note in release notes. We should also avoid auto-rollback during window. I'll add a release-note flag. :thumbsup:

adele: proposed values snippet for scheduling grace (canary-specific):
```yaml
canary:
  scheduling:
    graceSeconds: 300 # wait up to 5m for nodes to come up before fail
    maxUnavailable: 20%
```

joan: if we apply that now the canary controller will tolerate the pending state and not mark as failed immediately. But pinning is safest short-term.

mohit: i'm going to pin chart -> set chart.version: 1.4.2 in the release override and trigger a manual promotion hold. Who can push?

luca: I can push the override and update release notes. Command I'll run: `helm upgrade payments-service ./chart --set chart.version=1.4.2 -f override-euw.yaml --wait`

joan: sample override file I pushed to the release branch: `overrides/3921001234-pin-to-1.4.2.yaml` (contains the chart.version override + short note).

sre-bot: reminder: if you pin, make sure the deploy-bot exemption flag is set so the canary doesn't re-trigger automated rollback. Use annotation `release.redwood/exempt-rollback: "true"`.

mohit: applying now. will also add the scheduling grace snippet as a canary-only patch so we can test stability before promoting.

deploy-bot: patch applied: payments-service override (chart.version=1.4.2) by luca. Canary restart scheduled in 30s.

joan: checking pods: most pending cleared after scale-up; new canary pods are starting. metrics look like errors dropping back to ~0.5%

adele: great. Luca, capture in release notes that we pinned to 1.4.2 and added a temporary canary scheduling grace to avoid autoscaler races. Also add a follow-up ticket to remove the grace after root cause triage.

luca: will do. Release notes line: "Pinned payments-service to 1.4.2 after canary scheduling failures in eu-west-1; temporary canary scheduling grace added (5m)."

mohit: leaving this thread in HOLD until next maintenance window 2026-03-21 22:00 UTC. No automatic promote.

joan: monitoring for the next 30m. If errors stay <1% and no new scheduling failures, we'll close.

sre-bot: added incident tag and created ticket RINF-4921 for autoscaler behavior in eu-west-1.

luca: ack, closing manual hold but will keep watch. :eyes:
